crossrefs.text: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
asking, “Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews? We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.”
Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.
You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’
“I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”
In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.
Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
And the LORD informed me, so I knew. Then You showed me their deeds.

For I was like a gentle lamb led to slaughter; I did not know that they had plotted against me: “Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be remembered no more.”

When Herod saw that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was filled with rage. Sending orders, he put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, according to the time he had learned from the Magi.
For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
‘Let us invade Judah, terrorize it, and divide it among ourselves. Then we can install the son of Tabeal over it as king.’
But this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘It will not arise; it will not happen.
